descMain: The editor itself: the program, shortcuts and the uninstall entry. Required. Textures, models and the compilers come from your own copy of Garry's Mod in Steam.
descWebView2: The Windows component the editor's interface runs in. Installed only when the system does not have it yet; the bootstrapper is built into this installer.
descClaude: Anthropic's program that the built-in assistant needs to run on a Claude subscription. Installed with Anthropic's official installer: needs an internet connection, about a minute. Without it the assistant runs in demo mode or with an API key; it can also be installed later from the assistant's settings.
claudeInstalling: Installing Claude Code with Anthropic's official installer…
claudeFailed: Claude Code could not be installed (no internet connection, or Anthropic's installer is unavailable). The assistant will run in demo mode; it can be installed later from its settings.
licenseWait: Please read the terms: the “Next” button opens after a short countdown. Continuing means you accept them.
licenseSub: Please read the license terms before installing Mallet.
